Pip’s still got some pep.

Video

“Uh. It’s Tuesday. I know I’m bad with months. But is it supposed to be this cold? Don’t get me wrong. This is some solid napping weather. But this is weird. Zoë loves it though. And now that my leg feels better I get to do zoomies and whizzies with the pack, which is easier when it’s on the chilly side. Also, I love you.”

Look at this and realize I’m still alive?




𝒢𝒾𝓁𝒷ℯ𝓇𝓉 (@AbakpaJob)

How do I teach my body that my fight or flight response is supposed to be for life or death situations, not answering an email



— https://nitter.net/AbakpaJob/status/2046184475919368521#m

So many of our problems could be fixed by eliminating teachers unions.


John Collins (@Logically_JC)

So many of our problems could be fixed by properly funding public education.



— https://nitter.net/Logically_JC/status/2045489587015778364#m

The question is “US Under Trump.” Suggests that it’s more of a commentary on Trump than long term interests. Still bad tho.


Jostein Hauge (@haugejostein)

This is a remarkable shift.

People in *every single one* of the top US-allied countries now believe it’s better to depend on China than on the US.

The global balance of power is clearly tilting away from the US and toward China.





— https://nitter.net/haugejostein/status/2045173456455790887#m

“Good morning. It’s Monday. A trash panda got in our garbage and stole some bagels. Zoë got the critter’s smell license plate and wants to track them down. Meanwhile a nice man at the park gave me some scritches and pats. He asked me to drop my ball so he could throw it. I told him I couldn’t possibly do that now because I was late for a nap.  But maybe another time. Also, I love you.”
“Good morning. It’s Friday. Don’t be frightened by my collar. It’s for scaring away mean dogs. At least that’s what they told me. Also, I love you.”
I forgot I’ve had an account here since 2023. Kicking the tires now.
Giving this a whirl. This is my first Bluesky post and, yes, I'm tweeting pictures of my dogs. Don't say you weren't warned.
